# Browser dependencies

Locally vendored official npm distributions:

- markdown-it 15.0.2: `dist/browser/markdown-it.umd.min.js` (MIT)
- markdown-it-container 4.0.0: `dist/markdown-it-container.min.js` (MIT)
- DOMPurify 3.4.16: `dist/purify.min.js` (Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0)

Upstream source maps are not vendored. Licenses are included beside the bundles.
No runtime CDN or Node build is required. Update the version and license together.
